raw_response:
Maize is our food, so this plot gets the most attention. If I can get the FISP coupon this year I will use the NPK and urea on it — I usually stretch one bag of each across the plot, maybe a little less than the 0.4 ha it is meant for, so the rate comes out moderate. I will plant hybrid seed from the coupon where I can and mix in some groundnut on the ridges as I always do. Most work my wife and I do ourselves with the hand hoe, but at first weeding I sometimes call one or two neighbours on ganyu if the rains push the weeds too fast.
